name: Residential Swimming Pool
description: Complete dual-coat cementitious waterproofing and specialized mosaic tile installation.
fullDetails: This private luxury residence in Nairobi required reliable long-term waterproofing for an in-ground swimming pool. The structure was prepared with substrate smoothing, followed by application of Ultraguard 2K cementitious waterproofing and Simba Grip 818 C2TES1 adhesive for mosaic tile fixing.
scope: 350 m² pool basin, overflow channels, and balance tank waterproofing.

name: Commercial Basement
description: Heavy-duty below-ground foundation tanking and retaining wall waterproofing system.
fullDetails: A multi-level commercial development in Nairobi required robust basement tanking to prevent lateral ground moisture and high water table infiltration. Matshepo Africa delivered engineered waterproofing solutions covering retaining walls, construction joints, and basement slabs.
scope: 1,200 m² multi-level underground parking and foundation walls.

name: Apartment Rooftop
description: High-exposure flat roof deck waterproofing protecting multi-unit residential living spaces.
fullDetails: A premium residential apartment complex in Nairobi required full roof rehabilitation to eliminate chronic monsoon season leaks. The installation incorporated proper surface slope correction, fillet detailing, and multi-layer UV-stable waterproofing with a 10-year project guarantee.
scope: 850 m² exposed roof terrace and utility penthouse slabs.

name: Hotel Washrooms
description: Multi-floor wet area tanking before porcelain tile installation across luxury hotel suites.
fullDetails: For a boutique hospitality project in Nairobi, complete under-tile tanking was executed across 48 guest bathrooms and commercial laundry facilities to ensure zero inter-floor moisture migration.
scope: 48 guest suites and central laundry facility wet areas.

name: Residential Balcony
description: Cantilevered balcony slab protection against wind-driven rain and facade moisture stains.
fullDetails: Residential tower balconies in Nairobi received comprehensive edge detailing and flexible waterproofing barriers beneath large-format porcelain pavers to protect exterior facades from efflorescence and structural slab rebar degradation.
scope: 32 private balcony slabs and penthouse verandas.

name: Commercial Showroom Flooring
description: Refined seamless microcement surface finish for contemporary industrial retail showroom.
fullDetails: A premier architectural interior project featuring Cemora microcement flooring across customer reception and product demonstration galleries, delivering a sleek minimalist concrete aesthetic.
scope: 400 m² open gallery and reception floor space.
